header.title: Slider
header.description: Picks a numeric value or a range by dragging or with the keyboard. An array in `value` or `defaultValue` switches to range mode with two thumbs.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and see the result and code instantly.
playground.label: Volume
playground.helperText: Drag the thumb or use arrow keys.

base.title: Base
base.description: A single value with `label`, `defaultValue` and the readout above the thumb.

texts.label: Volume
texts.helperText: Drag the thumb or use arrow keys.

range.title: Range
range.description: An array in `defaultValue` shows two thumbs that cannot cross. `minAriaLabel` and `maxAriaLabel` name each thumb.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` forces the error tone and shows the message with role="alert".

texts.label: Budget
texts.errorMessage: Choose a value of at least 25.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: The seven tones available in the `tone` prop.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg. They change the track height and the thumb size.

step.title: Step
step.description: `min`, `max` and `step` set the range and increment. `formatValue` formats the readout and aria-valuetext.

prefixSuffix.title: Prefix and suffix
prefixSuffix.description: `prefix` and `suffix` are added to each value. A space is inserted when the suffix starts with a letter.

texts.label: Duration
texts.infoText: Choose the start and end of the period.

withoutValue.title: Without value readout
withoutValue.description: `showValue={false}` hides the value above the thumb.

withTooltip.title: With tooltip
withTooltip.description: `infoText` adds an info icon in the label row, aligned to the right.

texts.label: Radius
texts.infoText: Controls the corner radius applied to cards.
texts.helperText: The icon uses the shared field tooltip.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the value with `value` and `onChange`, which fires while dragging or using the keyboard.

controlledRange.title: Controlled range
controlledRange.description: With an array in `value`, `onChange` receives a [start, end] tuple.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, Slider accepts native <div> attributes (HTMLAttributes) except onChange and defaultValue. They go to the root, like className and wrapperClassName. With name, a hidden <input type="hidden"> (two in range mode, the second with maxName) submits the value in a form.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: Each thumb is a <button role="slider"> with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext (using formatValue, prefix and suffix).
a11y.range: In range mode the control uses role="group" and each thumb is named by minAriaLabel and maxAriaLabel (defaults: Minimum and Maximum).
a11y.keyboard: Arrow keys move one step; PageUp/PageDown move 10% of the range; Home and End jump to the minimum and maximum.
a11y.label: The label names the thumb through aria-labelledby. With no visible label, pass aria-label. helperText and errorMessage are linked through aria-describedby.
a11y.states: isInvalid/errorMessage, isRequired and isDisabled add aria-invalid, aria-required and aria-disabled to each thumb.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Class names applied based on props. Useful for styling with CSS.

rules.header: Row with the label and the info icon.
rules.control: Interactive area (drag and click). role="group" in range mode.
rules.rail: Container of the track and thumbs.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Each tone and size sets these variables. Redefine them on your `wrapperClassName` to change colors and dimensions without overriding rules.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <div> attributes (except onChange and defaultValue).

items.step: Increment. Values snap to this step.
items.value: Controlled value. Use a tuple for a range.
items.defaultValue: Uncontrolled initial value. Use a tuple for a range.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.helperText: Helper text below (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error message. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon next to the label.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.tone: Fill tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.showValue: Shows the value above each thumb.
items.suffix: Text after each value (e.g. %). Adds a space when it starts with a letter.
items.minAriaLabel: Accessible name of the start thumb in range mode.
items.maxAriaLabel: Accessible name of the end thumb in range mode.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.name: Name of the hidden input (or the start thumb in range mode).
items.maxName: Name of the end thumb hidden input in range mode.
items.id: Root id and base for internal ids.
items.aria-label: Accessible name when there is no label.
items.className: Extra classes for the root container.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Fires while the value changes: a number, or a tuple in range mode.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
